title: Specify and test common cleanup-completion observation ordering
outcome: Specify and test common cleanup-completion observation ordering
acceptance: Document whether completion before any stop and an Unresolved observation after Confirmed are valid; implement the intended fail-closed ordering without letting stale token/Arc observations clear successor ownership.
Portable controls cover before-stop, after-Confirmed, unresolved/error and foreign-owner observations, plus the authorized focused/full gate and independent review.
